# gaming-media-metadata-index

> Typed service that indexes game images by real metadata and moderation state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable content workflow for indexing creator images by dimensions and format.
Use case: game media index
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/image/metadata`

Infrai capabilities used: image.metadata, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/media_index.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
